A literal crazy night with a stranger in a strange place.
Ha Eun-Jo considered it a one-night stand and a secret. Until she met that man again in Seoul.

"Secretary Ha, we should introduce ourselves quickly. It's CEO Seo Do-Jin, isn't it?"

Seo Do-Jin, Hyunseong's sole successor and her one-night stand. Eunjo was assigned to the Planning and Strategy Team, or more precisely, to be Seo Do-Jin's assistant.
